description: The grouped bar chart illustrates the "effect" of various models across four linguistic categories, based on the paper "Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models." The horizontal category axis, labeled "tag," displays four categories in the following order: "case," "gender," "number," and "tense." The vertical value axis, labeled "effect," uses a linear scale with a visible range from slightly below 0 up to 20, featuring numeric tick labels at intervals of 5 and corresponding horizontal grid lines. The chart features grouped bars, with each group containing six bars that represent different models, as indicated by a legend in the top right corner. Within each group, the bars are arranged from left to right as follows: a light blue bar corresponding to an unlabeled entry marked with a solid gray rectangle in the legend, a dark blue bar labeled "XLM-L₂," a light green bar labeled "mBERT-R₂," a dark green bar labeled "XLM-R₂," a light pink bar labeled "mBERT-B₂," and a dark red bar labeled "XLM-B₂." Every bar is outlined in black and includes a prominent black error bar extending above and below its top edge. The "case" category contains the tallest bars overall, with the light pink "mBERT-B₂" bar reaching approximately 12.5 and the dark red "XLM-B₂" bar reaching approximately 11. The values generally decrease across the subsequent categories. In the "gender" category, values range from roughly 0.5 for "XLM-L₂" to 4 for "mBERT-B₂." The "number" category shows values between approximately 0.5 and 2.5. The "tense" category contains the shortest bars, with values hovering near zero; the light green "mBERT-R₂" bar in this group dips slightly below zero to approximately -0.1. The categories on the horizontal axis are not sorted alphabetically or by value, while the bars within each group follow a consistent order across all categories.
